name: Psychiatry
boundaries: Psychiatry: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Objective biomarker diagnosis for all psychiatric disorders
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by PSY-01, with a measurement overlap flagged under PSY-06. The historical demand for every disorder, and the “>95 percent” figure, are not adopted. PSY-01’s proposed bar is a mechanism partition of at least one major syndrome in ordinary practice.

original_dispositions.original_title: Curative treatment for schizophrenia targeting core pathophysiology
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by PSY-02. The required demonstration is durable cognitive and functional recovery after the intervention stops.

original_dispositions.original_title: Rapid-acting antidepressant that remits in hours and lasts years
original_dispositions.reason: Rapid action is already achieved with ketamine and esketamine. The unsolved capability is years of freedom from recurrence after a time-limited course. The combined “hours and years” slogan is not used as the completion test.

original_dispositions.original_title: Preventive intervention that blocks post-traumatic stress disorder after trauma
original_dispositions.reason: It is not absorbed into PSY-04 or PSY-08. The “>90 percent” figure is not adopted.

original_dispositions.original_title: Mechanistic cure for severe substance use disorders across all substances
original_dispositions.reason: The first demonstration is one specified substance. Generality across substances, behavioral addictions, and absence of anhedonia are further consequences, stated inside PSY-09.

original_dispositions.original_title: Unified transdiagnostic model with causal predictive power
original_dispositions.reason: A framework that explains every disorder and predicts every trajectory is a program that would still need the individual partition in PSY-01 and, for prevention, PSY-04. The 2025 ECNP roadmap is an explicit plan to fold biology into existing syndromes. It is not a completed individual causal model. Adding the theory as its own concept would count a restatement of PSY-01.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe and effective pharmacological or biological enhancer of psychotherapy
original_dispositions.reason: The bar is replacement of a full course by a pre-specified brief protocol. A small add-on effect does not qualify.

original_dispositions.original_title: Root-cause treatment for anorexia nervosa and other severe eating disorders
original_dispositions.reason: The clinical seriousness is real. A mechanism-designed treatment would be an instance of PSY-05. A durable change in course would follow the same demonstration logic as PSY-02 or PSY-03. Those entries can record an anorexia result if it appears. A separate ID would split the same principle by diagnosis. No claim is made here about family-based treatment remission rates, because no source for those rates was opened.

original_dispositions.original_title: Reliable early detection and prevention of first-episode psychosis
original_dispositions.reason: The “>80 percent” success figure is not adopted. Shortening the high-risk transition without a sustained drop in incidence would fail the existing proposed bar.

original_dispositions.original_title: Neurobiological mechanism and reversal of dissociation, depersonalization, and dissociative identity disorder
original_dispositions.reason: A reproducible, reversible circuit control of a core dissociative symptom would be an instance of PSY-07. The historical item supplies a diagnosis-shaped application of that capability. No verified grand-challenge document was found that separates it as its own principle. Evidence gap: the dissociation treatment literature was not reviewed systematically in this pass, so absence of a separate ID is a scope decision, not a claim that no clinical progress exists.

reconciliation_change_log.change: First-pass concepts PSY-01 through PSY-10 are all retained. None was deleted, replaced, or merged.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Every first-pass concept is retained under its original ID.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added the 2025 ECNP roadmap as a plan to bring biology into syndromes, and a December 2025 news report of genetic clusters as group-level evidence. Stated that no accuracy percentage is adopted. Flagged the boundary with PSY-06.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The primary genetic paper was not opened in this revision, so it is not used as evidence that a clinician can assign an individual to a mechanism-defined disease.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Corrected the FDA wording to the release’s phrase “as opposed to dopamine receptors.” Flagged the boundary with PSY-10.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: PSY-02 is the course change, and PSY-10 is one proposed biological route to it.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended the current state so that rapid antidepressant action is treated as already achieved. Added SUSTAIN-1 and the 2022 ketamine-maintenance review. The completion bar remains years off the investigational treatment. Flagged the boundary with PSY-12.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Continued dosing delays relapse and benefit after cessation is measured in weeks.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Stated that no fixed prevention percentage is adopted. Flagged PSY-11 as a different prevention window. Removed the unverified author name previously attached to the 2024 omega-3 network meta-analysis.
Clarified that a later disease-specific cure would still be an instance of this design method.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: No new trial evidence changed the gap.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Replaced an unverified Kendler quotation with a verified sentence from the same 28 October 2026 Nature feature. Flagged the boundary with PSY-01.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The earlier “almost always” wording was not found again and is not reused.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Flagged dissociation as a possible future instance.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: No new trial changed the n-of-1 and placebo gaps.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Flagged the consolidation-window boundary with the new PSY-11. Identity unchanged.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The two operations sit on opposite sides of the consolidation window.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Narrowed the first demonstration to one specified severe substance disorder. Cross-substance coverage, behavioral addictions, and freedom from anhedonia are recorded as further consequences.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The proposed majority-at-12-months figure remains a proposal.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Unchanged in substance. The boundary with PSY-02 is now stated in both entries.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: PSY-02 is the course change, and PSY-10 is one proposed biological route to it.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PSY-11 added. The historical “prevent PTSD after trauma” item is a different operation from reconsolidation (PSY-08) and from psychosis or mood prevention (PSY-04). The historical “>90 percent” figure is not adopted.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Cochrane evidence through 2024 shows the early-drug attempt is uncertain.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PSY-12 added. A session-level amplifier that lets a brief psychotherapy protocol match a full course is a change in scale and access, distinct from a small augmentation effect.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Nord and colleagues, 2023, place the average acute-augmentation effect at g = −0.27 and the D-cycloserine effect at g = −0.21. The larger psychotropic subgroup is not an approved general method and was not shown to replace a full course.
